description: Issue #862 correction, second instance: EtlSchedulerService.RerunFromSnapshotAsync resolves its own background WTMContext with no HTTP identity (TenantCode always null there -- see EtlSchedulerService's class-level remarks). This mutant removes the IgnoreQueryFilters() call from the EtlRunLog lookup at the top of RerunFromSnapshotAsync, reproducing the regression: a tenant-scoped EtlRunLog is no longer found by id, so the method's `if (runLog == null) return;` guard makes it silently no-op instead of restoring the job's watermark from the snapshot. Checked against EtlTenantIsolationTests.EtlScheduler_RerunFromSnapshot_FindsTenantScopedRunLog_DespiteNoAmbientTenantIdentity, which seeds a tenant-scoped EtlJobDefinition + EtlRunLog with a WatermarkSnapshot, calls RerunFromSnapshotAsync, and asserts the job's LastWatermarkValue was updated to the snapshot value -- with the mutant applied, the run log is never found so LastWatermarkValue stays unset (null) and the assertion fails. The green control, EtlDeadLetterRow_TenantA_CanReadOwnRow, is unrelated to the scheduler and proves the mutation's build/test environment itself is not broken.
target_symbol: EtlSchedulerService.RerunFromSnapshotAsync -- the .IgnoreQueryFilters() call on the runLog lookup
